source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 8 (PDF 107-121), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 8 (Applications of Computer Science) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Advanced innovations that are transforming how people live, work and communicate are called:
(Woh advanced innovations (jiddat) jo logon ke rehne, kaam karne aur rabta karne ka tareeqa badal rahi hain, kya kehlati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 8.1: emerging technologies (ubharti hui technologies) woh advanced innovations hain jo zindagi, kaam aur rabte ka tareeqa badal rahi hain.

book_ref.quote: Emerging technologies refer to advanced innovations that are transforming how people live

blocks.prompt:
2 Which group lists the four emerging technologies named in this chapter?
(Kaun sa group is chapter ki chaar emerging technologies ka hai?)

options.text: Cloud Computing, Assembler, Fax and Floppy disk
AI, IoT, Cloud Computing and Blockchain

blocks.explanation: Section 8.1 mein AI, IoT, Cloud Computing aur Blockchain ko industries badalne wali technologies kaha gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: creating smarter systems for managing data, automation, and connectivity

blocks.prompt:
3 Which of the following is an issue that emerging technologies introduce, according to Section 8.1?
(Section 8.1 ke mutabiq emerging technologies kaun sa masla (issue) bhi paida karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh naye hal dete hain magar data security, ethical concerns aur automation par inhisaar (dependence) jaise masail bhi laate hain; baqi options faide hain.

book_ref.quote: They offer new solutions to global and local challenges but also introduce issues

blocks.prompt:
4 According to the chapter, AI, IoT, Cloud Computing and Blockchain are shaping the next:
(Chapter ke mutabiq AI, IoT, Cloud Computing aur Blockchain agla kya shape kar rahi hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 8.1 ke Tidbit mein hai ke yeh technologies agla digital inqilab (revolution) la rahi hain.

book_ref.quote: connecting people, data, and devices across the world

blocks.prompt:
5 AI allows computers to analyze data, recognize patterns and make decisions with:
(AI computers ko data analyze karne, patterns pehchanne aur faisle karne deta hai, kis tarah?)
blocks.explanation: AI computer ko bohat kam insani madad (minimal human input) se faisle karne deta hai.

book_ref.quote: It allows computers to analyze data, recognize patterns, and make decisions with minimal human input.

blocks.prompt:
6 The process through which AI systems learn from experience, with algorithms trained on large sets of data, is called:
(Woh amal jis se AI systems tajurbe se seekhte hain aur algorithms bade data par train hote hain, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: AI systems machine learning (machine ka seekhna) se tajurba hasil karte hain; algorithms bade data sets par train hote hain.

book_ref.quote: AI systems learn from experience through a process called machine learning

blocks.prompt:
7 According to the chapter, what happens when an AI system processes more data?
(Chapter ke mutabiq jab AI system zyada data process karta hai to kya hota hai?)

options.text: us ke nataij zyada durust ho jate hain
woh seekhna band kar deta hai
nataij kam durust ho jate hain
use algorithm ki zaroorat nahin rehti

blocks.explanation: System jitna zyada data process karta hai, us ke nataij utne zyada durust (accurate) hote hain.

book_ref.quote: The more data the system processes, the more accurate its results become.

blocks.prompt:
8 AI performs intelligent tasks by combining which three things?
(AI kin teen cheezon ko mila kar intelligent kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: AI data, algorithms aur computing power ko mila kar speech samajhna aur tasveer mein cheezein pehchanna jaise kaam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: AI works by combining data, algorithms, and computing power to perform intelligent tasks

blocks.prompt:
9 Which technologies does AI use to simulate how the human brain processes information?
(AI insani dimagh ke maloomat process karne ki naqal ke liye kaun si technologies istemal karta hai?)

options.text: Neural Networks and Natural Language Processing

blocks.explanation: AI Neural Networks (NN) aur Natural Language Processing (NLP) se insani dimagh ke kaam ki naqal karta hai.

book_ref.quote: It uses technologies like Neural Networks (NN) and Natural Language Processing (NLP)

blocks.prompt:
10 AI helps in areas where traditional programming cannot handle:
(AI un shobon mein madad karta hai jahan riwayati programming kya handle nahin kar sakti?)
blocks.explanation: Jahan riwayati programming ghair yaqeeni surat-e-haal (uncertainty) ya bohat zyada maloomat handle na kar sake, wahan AI madad karta hai.

book_ref.quote: assist in areas where traditional programming cannot handle uncertainty or vast amounts of information

blocks.prompt:
11 Which of these is NOT listed in the chapter summary as a task needing human intelligence that AI performs?
(Chapter summary mein AI ke kaun se kaam ka zikr NAHIN jo insani zehanat mangta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Summary mein learning, reasoning, tasveer pehchanna, speech samajhna aur faisle karna hain. Bijli dena hardware ka kaam hai.

book_ref.quote: such as learning, reasoning, recognising images, understanding speech, and making decisions

blocks.prompt:
12 Siri, Alexa and Google Assistant are examples of:
(Siri, Alexa aur Google Assistant kis ki misalein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Siri, Alexa aur Google Assistant voice assistants hain jo bole gaye commands samajh kar jawab dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Voice assistants like Siri, Alexa, and Google Assistant understand spoken commands

blocks.prompt:
13 An AI system that identifies faces, objects or medical conditions from photos and scans is a(n):
(Woh AI system jo photos aur scans se chehre, cheezein ya bimariyan pehchanta hai, kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Image recognition (tasveer pehchanna) system photos aur scans se chehre, cheezein ya bimari pehchanta hai.

book_ref.quote: while image recognition systems identify faces, objects, or medical conditions

blocks.prompt:
14 On websites, which AI application helps customers by answering their questions?
(Websites par kaun si AI application customers ke sawalon ke jawab de kar madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Websites par chatbots customers ke sawalon ke jawab dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Chatbots on websites help customers by answering questions

blocks.prompt:
15 On YouTube, Daraz and Amazon, AI is used in recommendation systems to:
(YouTube, Daraz aur Amazon par AI recommendation systems mein kis liye istemal hota hai?)

options.text: user ki pasand ke mutabiq videos ya products suggest karna

blocks.explanation: Recommendation systems user ki pasand ke mutabiq videos ya products suggest karte hain.

book_ref.quote: to suggest videos or products based on user preferences

blocks.prompt:
16 In transportation, self-driving cars use AI to:
(Transportation mein self-driving cars AI ko kis liye istemal karti hain?)

options.text: ird-gird ko samajhna aur mehfooz driving ke faisle karna

blocks.explanation: Self-driving cars AI se apne ird-gird ko samajhti aur mehfooz driving ke faisle karti hain.

book_ref.quote: self-driving cars use AI to interpret their surroundings

blocks.prompt:
17 AI brings benefits to modern life by increasing:
(AI jadeed zindagi mein kya barha kar faida deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: AI karkardagi (efficiency), durustagi (accuracy) aur aasani (convenience) barhata hai.

book_ref.quote: AI brings significant benefits to modern life by increasing efficiency, accuracy, and convenience.

blocks.prompt:
18 According to the chapter, DeepMind's AI can analyze 3D eye scans to help predict:
(Chapter ke mutabiq DeepMind ka AI 3D aankh ke scans dekh kar kya predict karne mein madad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: DeepMind ka AI 3D eye scans se glaucoma jaisi aankh ki bimariyan wazeh alamaat se pehle predict karne mein madad karta hai.

book_ref.quote: DeepMind's AI can analyze 3D eye scans

blocks.prompt:
19 Companies such as Amazon and Daraz use AI chatbots mainly to:
(Amazon aur Daraz jaisi companiyan AI chatbots zyada tar kis liye istemal karti hain?)

options.text: hazaron users ke sawalon ka aik saath jawab dena

blocks.explanation: Amazon aur Daraz AI chatbots se hazaron users ke sawalon, jaise 'Where is my order?', ka aik saath jawab dete hain.

book_ref.quote: for thousands of users at the same time

blocks.prompt:
20 AI supports education through:
(AI taleem mein kis tarah madad karta hai?)

options.text: personalized learning aur adaptive tutoring systems

blocks.explanation: AI har talib-e-ilm ke mutabiq taleem (personalized learning) aur adaptive tutoring systems se madad karta hai.

book_ref.quote: AI supports education through personalized learning and adaptive tutoring systems.

blocks.prompt:
21 Which of the following is a challenge of AI in society mentioned in the chapter?
(In mein se kaun si AI ki mushkil (challenge) chapter mein bayan hui hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mushkilat mein data privacy, naukriyon ka chhin jana (job displacement) aur algorithms mein bias shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: Concerns include data privacy, job displacement, and bias in algorithms

blocks.prompt:
22 Farmers use AI with drones and sensors to monitor crops in order to:
(Kisaan drones aur sensors ke saath AI kis liye istemal karte hain?)

options.text: paidawar barhana aur zaya kam karna

blocks.explanation: Tidbit ke mutabiq kisaan AI, drones aur sensors se faslon ki nigrani kar ke paidawar barhate aur zaya kam karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Farmers use AI with drones and sensors to monitor crops

blocks.prompt:
23 A network of physical devices connected through the internet that can collect, share and act on data is called:
(Internet se jure physical devices ka network jo data jama, share aur us par amal kare, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Internet of Things (IoT) internet se jure physical devices ka network hai jo data jama, share aur us par amal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: a network of physical devices connected through the internet that can collect, share, and act on data

blocks.prompt:
24 IoT devices often include:
(IoT devices mein aksar kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: IoT devices mein aksar sensors, processors aur communication hardware hote hain.

book_ref.quote: These devices often include sensors, processors, and communication hardware

blocks.prompt:
25 IoT systems link devices through which of the following?
(IoT systems devices ko kis ke zariye jorte hain?)
blocks.explanation: IoT systems devices ko Wi-Fi, Bluetooth ya cellular networks jaisi wireless technologies se jorte hain.

book_ref.quote: through wireless communication technologies like Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, or cellular networks

blocks.prompt:
26 In the chapter's smart home example, smart LED bulbs can be set to turn on automatically at:
(Chapter ki smart home misal mein smart LED bulbs khud ba khud kis waqt jalne ke liye set ho sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Smart LED bulbs smartphone se on/off hote hain aur sham 6:00 baje khud jalne ke liye set kiye ja sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: set to turn on automatically at 6:00 p.m.

blocks.prompt:
27 In the smart home example, smart curtains close when the room temperature rises above:
(Smart home misal mein smart parde (curtains) kamre ka darja hararat kitne se upar jane par band hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Smart parde subah ke alarm par khulte aur 35 degree Celsius se upar hararat par band ho jate hain taake kamra thanda rahe.

book_ref.quote: close when the room temperature rises above 35

blocks.prompt:
28 In healthcare, IoT sensors monitoring heart rate and glucose levels in real time allow doctors to:
(Healthcare mein IoT sensors dil ki dhadkan aur glucose real time mein dekhte hain; is se doctor kya kar sakte hain?)

options.text: door se mareez ki sehat dekhna aur emergency mein jaldi jawab dena

blocks.explanation: Is se doctor door se mareez ki sehat dekh sakte aur emergency mein jaldi jawab de sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: IoT sensors can monitor patient conditions such as heart rate, blood pressure, or glucose levels

blocks.prompt:
29 Smart homes, wearable fitness bands and smart farms are all powered by:
(Smart homes, wearable fitness bands aur smart farms sab kis technology se chalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tidbit ke mutabiq smart homes, fitness bands aur smart farms sab IoT technology se chalte hain.

book_ref.quote: Smart homes, wearable fitness bands, and smart farms are all powered by IoT technology.

blocks.prompt:
30 IoT works through three main functions. Which option gives them?
(IoT teen bunyadi kaamon (functions) se chalta hai. Kaun sa option yeh teen batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: IoT ke teen bunyadi functions: data collection (data jama karna), communication (rabta) aur automation (khud kaar amal).

book_ref.quote: IoT works through three main functions: data collection, communication, and automation.

blocks.prompt:
31 In an IoT system, which part collects data such as temperature, movement or humidity from the environment?
(IoT system mein kaun sa hissa mahol se temperature, harkat ya nami ka data jama karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sensors mahol se temperature, harkat ya nami (humidity) ka data jama karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Sensors collect data from the environment, such as temperature, movement, or humidity.

blocks.prompt:
32 After sensors collect data, where is it sent to be processed and analyzed?
(Sensors ke data jama karne ke baad use process aur analyze karne ke liye kahan bheja jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Data cloud-based systems ya servers ko bheja jata hai jahan woh process aur analyze hota hai.

book_ref.quote: This data is then sent to cloud-based systems or servers where it is processed and analyzed.

blocks.prompt:
33 In IoT, automation reduces the need for manual control and so:
(IoT mein automation haath ke control ki zaroorat kam karta hai, is se kya hota hai?)

options.text: waqt bachata aur insani ghalti kam karta hai
devices ka rabta rok deta hai
zyada haath ka kaam mangta hai

blocks.explanation: Automation haath ke control ki zaroorat kam kar ke waqt bachata aur insani ghalti kam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Automation reduces the need for manual control, saving time and minimizing human error.

blocks.prompt:
34 Communication between IoT devices ensures that systems remain:
(IoT devices ke darmiyan rabta (communication) systems ko kaisa rakhta hai?)

options.text: haath se chalne wale aur mehenge

blocks.explanation: Devices ka rabta systems ko hum-aahang (synchronized) aur efficient rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Communication between devices ensures that systems remain synchronized and efficient.

blocks.prompt:
35 Cloud computing allows users to store, manage and process data on:
(Cloud computing users ko data kahan store, manage aur process karne deti hai?)

options.text: local computer ke bajaye remote servers par

blocks.explanation: Cloud computing data ko local computer ke bajaye door ke servers (remote servers) par rakhne aur process karne deti hai.

book_ref.quote: store, manage, and process data on remote servers instead of local computers

blocks.prompt:
36 The remote servers used in cloud computing are managed by:
(Cloud computing ke remote servers kaun manage karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh servers internet par hote hain aur cloud service providers inhein manage karte hain.

book_ref.quote: These servers are hosted on the internet and managed by cloud service providers.

blocks.prompt:
37 Why does the cloud remove the need for powerful personal computers?
(Cloud taqatwar personal computers ki zaroorat kyun khatam kar deta hai?)

options.text: zyada tar processing door (remotely) hoti hai
woh kaghazi backup istemal karta hai

blocks.explanation: Cloud mein zyada tar processing door servers par hoti hai, is liye taqatwar PC ki zaroorat nahin rehti.

book_ref.quote: The cloud eliminates the need for powerful personal computers

blocks.prompt:
38 Which of the following is a modern digital tool supported by cloud computing, according to the chapter?
(Chapter ke mutabiq cloud computing kis jadeed digital tool ko support karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cloud computing streaming platforms, online learning systems aur collaborative workspaces ko support karti hai.

book_ref.quote: It supports modern digital tools like streaming platforms, online learning systems, and collaborative workspaces.

blocks.prompt:
39 Saving a document on iCloud is an example of using:
(iCloud par document save karna kis cheez ke istemal ki misal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Do You Know box ke mutabiq Google Drive ya iCloud par document save karna cloud computing hai.

book_ref.quote: When you save a document on Google Drive or iCloud

blocks.prompt:
40 The ability of cloud users to easily increase or decrease storage space and computing power based on need is called:
(Cloud user ka zaroorat ke mutabiq storage aur computing power asani se barhana ya ghatana kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Scalability: zaroorat ke mutabiq storage aur computing power ko barhana ya ghatana; barhte karobar ke liye behtareen.

book_ref.quote: Users can easily increase or decrease their storage space and computing power based on need

blocks.prompt:
41 Working from multiple devices and locations without transferring files manually is which cloud advantage?
(Kai devices aur jagahon se baghair files haath se muntaqil kiye kaam karna cloud ka kaun sa faida hai?)
blocks.explanation: Accessibility (rasai): cloud services kai devices aur jagahon se baghair files muntaqil kiye kaam karne deti hain.

book_ref.quote: cloud services allow users to work from multiple devices and locations without transferring files manually

blocks.prompt:
42 In the pay-as-you-go model of cloud computing, users:
(Cloud computing ke pay-as-you-go model mein users kya karte hain?)

options.text: na istemal hone wale servers ka paisa dete hain
pehle sara hardware khareedna hota hai
sirf istemal ki gayi services ka paisa dete hain

blocks.explanation: Pay-as-you-go model mein user sirf utni services ka paisa deta hai jitni istemal kare; is se kharcha kam hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Users usually pay only for the services they use through a pay-as-you-go model

blocks.prompt:
43 Cloud computing is cost-effective because it reduces the need for:
(Cloud computing kifayati (cost-effective) kyun hai? Yeh kis cheez ki zaroorat kam karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cloud computing mehenge servers aur maintenance staff ki zaroorat kam karti hai, is liye kifayati hai.

book_ref.quote: it reduces the need for expensive servers and maintenance staff

blocks.prompt:
44 AWS stands for:
(AWS ka poora naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: AWS yani Amazon Web Services web hosting, data storage aur application development ki cloud services deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Amazon Web Services (AWS) offers a wide range of cloud-based services

blocks.prompt:
45 Which cloud platform does the chapter say enables developers to create and manage applications through the cloud, with capabilities similar to AWS?
(Chapter ke mutabiq kaun sa cloud platform AWS jaisi salahiyat rakhta hai aur developers ko cloud se applications banane deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Microsoft Azure AWS jaisi salahiyat deta hai aur developers cloud ke zariye applications bana aur sambhal sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: enabling developers to create and manage applications through the cloud

blocks.prompt:
46 Saving documents, hosting websites and running software remotely show that cloud computing has become:
(Documents save karna, websites host karna aur software door se chalana kya dikhata hai ke cloud computing kya ban chuki hai?)

options.text: jadeed digital infrastructure ka lazmi hissa

blocks.explanation: Cloud computing jadeed digital dhanche (infrastructure) ka lazmi hissa ban chuki hai.

book_ref.quote: cloud computing has become an essential part of modern digital infrastructure

blocks.prompt:
47 Blockchain stores and shares information:
(Blockchain maloomat kis tarah store aur share karta hai?)

options.text: aik markazi server ke bajaye bohat se computers par

blocks.explanation: Blockchain maloomat aik markazi server ke bajaye bohat se computers par mehfooz tareeqe se rakhta aur share karta hai.

book_ref.quote: securely stores and shares information across many computers instead of a single central server

blocks.prompt:
48 In blockchain, each verified record is called a ______ and links to the previous one.
(Blockchain mein har tasdeeq shuda record ko kya kehte hain jo pichhle se jura hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har tasdeeq shuda record block kehlata hai aur pichhle block se jur kar na badalne wali chain banata hai.

book_ref.quote: Each verified record, or block, links to the previous one, forming an unchangeable chain.

blocks.prompt:
49 Why is altering data in a blockchain without detection nearly impossible?
(Blockchain mein baghair pakray data badalna taqreeban namumkin kyun hai?)

options.text: data aik server par hota hai
har computer ke paas copy hoti hai

blocks.explanation: Kyunke har computer ke paas copy hoti hai, is liye chupke se data badalna taqreeban namumkin hai.

book_ref.quote: Because every computer holds a copy, altering data without detection is nearly impossible.

blocks.prompt:
50 The decentralized structure of blockchain increases trust by removing:
(Blockchain ka decentralized dhancha kya hata kar aitbaar barhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Decentralized (ghair markazi) dhancha banks ya hukoomat jaise darmiyani idaron (intermediaries) ko hata kar aitbaar barhata hai.

book_ref.quote: by removing intermediaries like banks or governments

blocks.prompt:
51 In finance, blockchain powers cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin for:
(Finance mein blockchain Bitcoin jaisi cryptocurrencies ko kis liye chalata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Finance mein blockchain Bitcoin jaisi cryptocurrencies se mehfooz peer-to-peer (seedhe aapas mein) len-den karata hai.

book_ref.quote: In finance, it powers cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin

blocks.prompt:
52 In data security, blockchain provides tamper-proof storage for records such as:
(Data security mein blockchain kin records ke liye tamper-proof storage deta hai?)

options.text: legal documents, medical files aur certificates

blocks.explanation: Data security mein blockchain legal documents, medical files aur certificates ke liye na chhedne wala (tamper-proof) storage deta hai.

book_ref.quote: it provides tamper-proof storage for records like legal documents, medical files, and certificates

blocks.prompt:
53 According to the chapter, governments, companies and schools use blockchain to manage:
(Chapter ke mutabiq hukoomat, companiyan aur school blockchain se kya manage karte hain?)

options.text: zameen ke records, supply chains aur taleemi asnaad

blocks.explanation: Hukoomat, companiyan aur school blockchain se zameen ke records, supply chains aur taleemi asnaad manage karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Governments, companies, and schools use blockchain to manage land records

blocks.prompt:
54 The chapter summary describes blockchain as a digital record-keeping technology in which data is stored in:
(Chapter summary ke mutabiq blockchain mein data kis shakal mein store hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Blockchain record rakhne ki digital technology hai jis mein data jure hue blocks mein hota hai.

book_ref.quote: It is commonly used to support secure, transparent, and tamper-resistant transactions.

blocks.text: 8.2 Cultural and Ethical Implications of AI Systems

blocks.prompt:
55 According to Section 8.2, AI systems are not only technical creations but also:
(Section 8.2 ke mutabiq AI systems sirf technical takhleeq nahin balke aur kya hain?)

options.text: samaji auzaar jo afraad, communities aur hukoomaton par asar dalte hain
aise auzaar jin ka logon par koi asar nahin

blocks.explanation: AI systems samaji auzaar (social tools) bhi hain jo afraad, communities aur hukoomaton par asar dalte hain.

book_ref.quote: AI systems are not only technical creations but also social tools

blocks.prompt:
56 In an AI system, which stakeholder group regulates its applications?
(AI system mein kaun sa stakeholder group us ki applications ko regulate (qaida mein) karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Developers AI banate, users istemal karte, hukoomat regulate karti aur communities us ka asar mehsoos karti hain.

book_ref.quote: Developers design and program AI models, users interact with them in daily activities

blocks.prompt:
57 Which stakeholders design and build AI systems, focusing on functionality, innovation and performance?
(Kaun se stakeholders functionality, innovation aur performance par tawajjuh de kar AI systems banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Developers functionality, innovation aur performance par tawajjuh de kar AI systems banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Developers design and build AI systems focusing on functionality, innovation, and performance.

blocks.prompt:
58 Users of AI systems are mainly concerned about:
(AI systems ke users ko zyada tar kis baat ki fikr hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Users chahte hain ke AI aasan aur qabil-e-aitbaar ho; unhein privacy, security aur durust nataij ki fikr hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: They are concerned about privacy, security, and correct outcomes.

blocks.prompt:
59 Which stakeholder group focuses on preserving social values and cultural norms?
(Kaun sa stakeholder group samaji aqdaar aur saqafati riwayaat bachane par tawajjuh deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Communities samaji aqdaar (values) aur saqafati usool (norms) bachane par tawajjuh deti hain.

book_ref.quote: Communities focus on preserving social values and cultural norms.

blocks.prompt:
60 Governments, as stakeholders in AI, work to:
(AI ke stakeholder ke taur par hukoomat kya kaam karti hai?)

options.text: awam ke mafaad ki hifazat aur qanoon par amal karwana
sirf munafe ke liye AI bechna

blocks.explanation: Hukoomat policies aur regulations banati hai, awam ke mafaad ki hifazat karti aur qanoon par amal karwati hai.

book_ref.quote: They work to protect public interests and enforce legal compliance.

blocks.prompt:
61 Individuals or groups affected by a technology system are called:
(Woh afraad ya groups jin par koi technology system asar dale, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Stakeholders woh afraad ya groups hain jin par technology system ka asar parta hai.

book_ref.quote: Stakeholders are individuals or groups affected by a technology system.

blocks.prompt:
62 A conflict of interest arises between businesses and users because businesses aim to collect data for innovation and profit while users value:
(Businesses aur users mein conflict kyun hota hai? Businesses data jama karna chahte hain jabke users kis cheez ko ahmiyat dete hain?)

options.text: privacy aur zaati maloomat par ikhtiyar

blocks.explanation: Businesses munafe aur innovation ke liye data chahte hain jabke users apni privacy aur zaati maloomat par ikhtiyar chahte hain.

book_ref.quote: Businesses aim to collect data for innovation and profit, while users value privacy

blocks.prompt:
63 In the conflict among stakeholders, governments must balance economic growth with:
(Stakeholders ke conflict mein hukoomat ko maashi taraqqi ke saath kis cheez ka tawazun rakhna hota hai?)

options.text: shehriyon ke huqooq ki hifazat aur akhlaqi meyar
baghair ijazat zyada data jama karna

blocks.explanation: Hukoomat ko maashi taraqqi aur shehriyon ke huqooq ki hifazat aur akhlaqi meyar mein tawazun rakhna hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Governments must balance economic growth with protecting citizens' rights

blocks.prompt:
64 When companies gather large amounts of user data to improve AI without explicit consent, this:
(Jab companiyan AI behtar karne ke liye baghair wazeh ijazat ke bohat sa user data jama karein to kya hota hai?)

options.text: privacy aur aitbaar ki khilaf warzi hai

blocks.explanation: Baghair wazeh ijazat (explicit consent) ke data jama karna privacy aur aitbaar ki khilaf warzi hai.

book_ref.quote: but without explicit consent, this violates privacy and trust

blocks.prompt:
65 What helps achieve a fair balance between functionality and ethics in data collection?
(Data jama karne mein functionality aur ethics ke darmiyan munasib tawazun kis se hasil hota hai?)
